items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I heard this sound of this trumpet... She said, 'That’s Louis Armstrong.' I said, 'I’d like to buy that.' And I did. And there you go. That started the whole thing.

ctx.x: Why did you choose the trumpet?

Well my first instrument was the upright alto horn, because it was available in the family, it was in the house. And I didn’t dig it man, you know, um pah, um pah, pah-pah-pah. And I wanted to play the trumpet and I saved my pennies and my first trumpet I bought for $35 and got into it. And then I played trumpet in the high school band and then the way my interests broadened, I was walking down the street in Buffalo as a teenager, in the ‘30s, and I heard this sound of this trumpet and I couldn’t believe it. And…
I guess so. I mean I’ve heard that story before. So he certainly had a large effect.
